name: statusline
description: Three-line Claude Code status line: user@host dir (git branch); model (effort), session tokens, context %; 5-hour/7-day rate limits with reset times; then one "🔧 <skill> (main)" line for the skill most recently loaded by the main agent and one per recent subagent, tagged with its agent type and the start of its description; the note in parentheses is dimmed. The statusline:setup skill installs a stable shim in the Claude config dir that always runs the installed plugin version.
